title: Entity Detector
description:
The Entity Detector is a block that emits a redstone signal if it detects a certain type of entity in a configurable radius around it. If you right click on the block it will open a gui in where you can change the radius (0 to 10 for each axis, 5 by default) & the type of entity the detector is supposed to react to (All, Living, Animals, Monsters, Players, Items or Custom). You can also invert the filter (If you invert "Players" the detector will emit a redstone signal while there is NO player inside of its radius). If you set the Filter to Custom the block will use the Entity Filter in its inventory slot as its filter; with no filter in the slot nothing is detected.

A button in the gui switches the output between Weak and Strong power.

properties.label: Redstone
properties.value: Power 15 while active; Weak (default) or Strong
